# =========================================================================
# 1. LIVE DATA INGESTION FROM SPECIFIED REPOSITORY
# =========================================================================

```{r}
#raw_url <- "https://github.com/webbegole/ebola-bundibugyo-tracker-2026/blob/main/data/timeseries.csv"

raw_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/webbegole/ebola-bundibugyo-tracker-2026/main/data/timeseries.csv"



raw_data <- read.csv(raw_url)

raw_data
```
```{r}
# Format dates and clean values
raw_data$report_date <- as.Date(raw_data$report_date)
raw_data <- raw_data[order(raw_data$report_date), ]

# Match population of North Kivu/Ituri (DRC) and Bundibugyo/western districts (Uganda)
N <- 12500000 

# Extract state definitions from structural columns
raw_data$R_obs <- raw_data$confirmed_deaths_global + raw_data$recovered_global
raw_data$I_obs <- raw_data$confirmed_global - raw_data$R_obs
raw_data$time  <- as.numeric(raw_data$report_date - min(raw_data$report_date)) + 1

# Filter data to exclude structural missing entries
clean_df <- na.omit(raw_data[, c("time", "I_obs", "R_obs")])

# =========================================================================
# 2. BASELINE BETA & GAMMA EXTRACTOR
# =========================================================================
sir_equations <- function(time, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    dS <- -(beta * S * I) / N
    dI <-  (beta * S * I) / N - gamma * I
    dR <-  gamma * I
    return(list(c(dS, dI, dR)))
  })
}

init_state <- c(S = N - clean_df$I_obs[1], I = clean_df$I_obs[1], R = clean_df$R_obs[1])

calculate_rss <- function(p) {
  names(p) <- c("beta", "gamma")
  if(any(p <= 0)) return(1e12)
  predictions <- as.data.frame(ode(y = init_state, times = clean_df$time, func = sir_equations, parms = p))
  return(sum((clean_df$I_obs - predictions$I)^2) + sum((clean_df$R_obs - predictions$R)^2))
}

# Run optimal deterministic derivation
fit <- optim(par = c(beta = 0.25, gamma = 0.08), fn = calculate_rss, method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = c(0.01, 0.01))
base_beta  <- fit$par["beta"]
base_gamma <- fit$par["gamma"]
base_r0    <- base_beta / base_gamma
```

### Real-Time Predictive Forecasting Sandbox (Interactive Chart)

<div style="display: flex; gap: 20px; font-family: sans-serif; padding: 10px; height: 100%;">

    <span id="valGamma" style="font-weight:bold; color:#5bc0de;">`r round(base_gamma, 4)`</span>
    
    <div style="margin-top: 30px; padding: 10px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;">
      <span style="font-size:13px; display:block;">Dynamic \(R_0\):</span>
      <strong id="valR0" style="font-size:20px; color:#c9302c;">`r round(base_r0, 2)`</strong>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div style="flex-grow: 1; position: relative;">
    <div id="plotly_sandbox_chart" style="width:100%; height:450px;"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Load Client-Side dependencies inside the pipeline bundle -->
<script src="https://plot.ly"></script>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  // Feed historical matrix rows generated by R variables into JavaScript Arrays
  const obs_time = [`r paste(clean_df$time, collapse=",")`];
  const obs_I = [`r paste(clean_df$I_obs, collapse=",")`];
  const obs_R = [`r paste(clean_df$R_obs, collapse=",")`];
  
  const N = `r N`;
  const maxDays = 180;
  
  function solveSIR(beta, gamma) {
    let S = N - obs_I[0];
    let I = obs_I[0];
    let R = obs_R[0];
    let dt = 1;
    
    let t_arr = [];
    let I_arr = [];
    let R_arr = [];
    
    for (let t = 1; t <= maxDays; t++) {
      t_arr.push(t);
      I_arr.push(I);
      R_arr.push(R);
      
      let dS = - (beta * S * I) / N;
      let dI =   (beta * S * I) / N - (gamma * I);
      let dR =   gamma * I;
      
      S += dS * dt;
      I += dI * dt;
      R += dR * dt;
    }
    return { t: t_arr, I: I_arr, R: R_arr };
  }

  function updateChart() {
    let beta = parseFloat(document.getElementById("sliderBeta").value);
    let gamma = parseFloat(document.getElementById("sliderGamma").value);
    
    document.getElementById("valBeta").innerText = beta.toFixed(4);
    document.getElementById("valGamma").innerText = gamma.toFixed(4);
    document.getElementById("valR0").innerText = (beta / gamma).toFixed(2);
    
    let sim = solveSIR(beta, gamma);
    
    let data = [
      { x: obs_time, y: obs_I, mode: 'markers', name: 'Observed Infected (Data)', marker: { color: '#777', size: 6 } },
      { x: sim.t, y: sim.I, mode: 'lines', name: 'Simulated Forecast (I)', line: { color: '#d9534f', width: 3 } },
      { x: sim.t, y: sim.R, mode: 'lines', name: 'Simulated Forecast (R)', line: { color: '#5cb85c', width: 2, dash: 'dot' } }
    ];
    
    let layout = {
      margin: { t: 20, b: 40, l: 60, r: 20 },
      xaxis: { title: 'Days Since Horizon Track' },
      yaxis: { title: 'Population Counts' },
      legend: { orientation: 'h', y: -0.15 }
    };
    
    Plotly.newPlot('plotly_sandbox_chart', data, layout);
  }

  document.getElementById("sliderBeta").addEventListener("input", updateChart);
  document.getElementById("sliderGamma").addEventListener("input", updateChart);
  
  // Initial canvas generation pass
  updateChart();
});
</script>

### Data Attribution & Methodology Framework

**Source Registry:** Automated tracking extraction targeting the `data/timeseries.csv` matrix array in the public `webbegole/ebola-bundibugyo-tracker-2026` repository. The optimization step executes an unconstrained multivariate `L-BFGS-B` routine across active windows to compute current biological constants during build phases. Use the dashboard controls to test specific alternative public health scenarios.
